local View = {}

	backgroundTop = Color3.fromRGB(7, 21, 38),
	backgroundBottom = Color3.fromRGB(3, 10, 20),
	backgroundAccent = Color3.fromRGB(18, 58, 96),
	panelText = Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255),

	nativeSurface = Color3.fromRGB(12, 30, 53),
	nativeSurface2 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 46, 77),
	nativeOutline = Color3.fromRGB(10, 35, 64),
	nativeGold = Color3.fromRGB(231, 185, 90),
	nativeCyan = Color3.fromRGB(60, 203, 255),
	nativeCyanSoft = Color3.fromRGB(119, 226, 255),
	success = Color3.fromRGB(83, 214, 179),
	danger = Color3.fromRGB(217, 106, 106),
	shadow = Color3.fromRGB(6, 16, 28),
	white = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),

local TITLE_PLATE_URI = "nexusasset://asset_6e85243962a64a119298e36898fbfeca"
local PLAY_BUTTON_URI = "nexusasset://asset_ba81bd104c04413fa1c4e5729414428e"
local MENU_BUTTON_URI = "nexusasset://asset_8db5d1f006c74515ab972c252cacf0e2"
local SETTINGS_PANEL_URI = "nexusasset://asset_e1cf723245834cbcadaeca083a47c684"
local CREDITS_PANEL_URI = "nexusasset://asset_c46f5bff5a3d4158adcb803c5cc3661a"
local CLOSE_BUTTON_URI = "nexusasset://asset_32051086979346beabb6bef4d2e707b9"
local TOGGLE_ON_URI = "nexusasset://asset_8caafb851c964d6fbc78ad6158bcfdfb"
local TOGGLE_OFF_URI = "nexusasset://asset_8244b798b2d44615b075162e34dd78ba"

local FONT_DISPLAY = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
local FONT_HEADING = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
local FONT_BUTTON = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
local FONT_BODY = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
local FONT_NUMERIC = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)

local function createNexusIcon(parent, role, options)
	options = options or {}
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = options.name or (role .. "Icon")
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(options.size or 32, options.size or 32)
	holder.Parent = parent

	local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	aspect.AspectRatio = 1
	aspect.Parent = holder

	local padding = math.clamp(options.padding or 12, 0, 25) / 100

	local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
	canvas.Name = "Glyph"
	canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	canvas.BorderSizePixel = 0
	canvas.Position = UDim2.fromScale(padding, padding)
	canvas.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 - padding * 2, 1 - padding * 2)
	canvas.Parent = holder

	local color = options.color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

	local function shape(x, y, w, h, rotation, round)
		local part = Instance.new("Frame")
		part.Name = "GlyphPart"
		part.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		part.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
		part.Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h)
		part.Rotation = rotation or 0
		part.BackgroundColor3 = color
		part.BorderSizePixel = 0
		part.Parent = canvas
		if round then
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(round, 0)
			corner.Parent = part
		end
		return part
	end

	local function bar(x1, y1, x2, y2, width)
		local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
		return shape((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), width or 0.14, math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)), 0.5)
	end

	local function ring(x, y, radius, width)
		for index = 0, 11 do
			local a, b = index * math.pi / 6, (index + 1) * math.pi / 6
			bar(x + math.cos(a) * radius, y + math.sin(a) * radius, x + math.cos(b) * radius, y + math.sin(b) * radius, width or 0.12)
		end
	end

	if role == "play" then
		for index = 0, 15 do
			local x = index / 16
			shape(0.22 + x * 0.58, 0.5, 0.58 / 16 + 0.005, 0.76 * (1 - x), 0, nil)
		end
	elseif role == "close" or role == "plus" then
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, role == "close" and 45 or 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, role == "close" and -45 or 90, 0.5)
	elseif role == "settings" then
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.25, 0.16)
		for index = 0, 7 do
			local angle = index * math.pi / 4
			shape(0.5 + math.cos(angle) * 0.33, 0.5 + math.sin(angle) * 0.33, 0.26, 0.16, math.deg(angle), 0.3)
		end
	else
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.39, 0.11)
		shape(0.5, 0.31, 0.14, 0.14, 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.62, 0.14, 0.3, 0, 0.4)
	end

	return holder
end

local function applyNativeShadow(parent, name, zIndex, transparency)
	local ok, shadow = pcall(Instance.new, "UIShadow")
	if ok and shadow then
		shadow.Name = name or "Shadow"
		shadow.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		shadow.Transparency = transparency or 0.72
		shadow.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
		shadow.Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6)
		shadow.Parent = parent
		parent.ZIndex = zIndex or parent.ZIndex
		return shadow
	end
	return nil
end

local function newTextLabel(name, text, fontFace, size, color)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextTransparency = 0
	label.TextScaled = false
	label.TextSize = size
	label.FontFace = fontFace
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.RichText = false
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	return label
end

local function addTextShadow(label)
	local shadow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	shadow.Name = "Shadow"
	shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shadow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)
	shadow.ZIndex = math.max(1, label.ZIndex - 1)
	shadow.Text = label.Text
	shadow.TextColor3 = PALETTE.nativeOutline
	shadow.TextTransparency = 0.35
	shadow.TextScaled = label.TextScaled
	shadow.TextSize = label.TextSize
	shadow.FontFace = label.FontFace
	shadow.TextWrapped = label.TextWrapped
	shadow.TextXAlignment = label.TextXAlignment
	shadow.TextYAlignment = label.TextYAlignment
	shadow.Parent = label.Parent
	return shadow
end

local function createSliceButton(nodeName, imageUri, sliceCenterArray, sliceScale, buttonHeight)
	local button = Instance.new("ImageButton")
	button.Name = nodeName
	button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.Image = imageUri
	button.ImageColor3 = PALETTE.white
	button.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	button.SliceCenter = Rect.new(sliceCenterArray[1], sliceCenterArray[2], sliceCenterArray[3], sliceCenterArray[4])
	button.SliceScale = sliceScale
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, buttonHeight)
	button.SelectionImageObject = nil

	local shadowHost = Instance.new("Frame")
	shadowHost.Name = "Shadow"
	shadowHost.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	shadowHost.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shadowHost.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	shadowHost.ZIndex = 1
	shadowHost.Parent = button
	applyNativeShadow(shadowHost, "NativeShadow", 1, 0.76)

	local visual = Instance.new("Frame")
	visual.Name = "Visual"
	visual.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	visual.BorderSizePixel = 0
	visual.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	visual.ZIndex = 2
	visual.Parent = button

	local skin = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	skin.Name = "Skin"
	skin.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	skin.BorderSizePixel = 0
	skin.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	skin.Image = imageUri
	skin.ImageColor3 = PALETTE.white
	skin.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	skin.SliceCenter = Rect.new(sliceCenterArray[1], sliceCenterArray[2], sliceCenterArray[3], sliceCenterArray[4])
	skin.SliceScale = sliceScale
	skin.ZIndex = 2
	skin.Parent = visual

	local gloss = Instance.new("Frame")
	gloss.Name = "Gloss"
	gloss.BackgroundColor3 = PALETTE.white
	gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
	gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
	gloss.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.08)
	gloss.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.34)
	gloss.ZIndex = 3
	gloss.Parent = visual

	local glossCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	glossCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.9, 0)
	glossCorner.Parent = gloss

	local glossGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	glossGradient.Rotation = 90
	glossGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	glossGradient.Parent = gloss

	return button
end

local function populateButtonContent(button, text, iconRole, iconSize, textSize)
	local visual = button:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.BorderSizePixel = 0
	content.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	content.ZIndex = 4
	content.Parent = visual

	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 20)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 20)
	padding.Parent = content

	local buttonIcon = createNexusIcon(content, iconRole, {
		name = button.Name .. "Icon",
		size = iconSize,
		padding = 10,
		color = PALETTE.panelText,
	})
	buttonIcon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	buttonIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
	buttonIcon.ZIndex = 5
	for _, desc in ipairs(buttonIcon:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Frame") then
			desc.ZIndex = 5
		end
	end

	local label = newTextLabel("Label", text, FONT_BUTTON, textSize, PALETTE.panelText)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(iconSize + 18), 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, iconSize + 14, 0, 0)
	label.ZIndex = 5
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = content

	local sizeConstraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
	sizeConstraint.MinTextSize = math.max(18, textSize - 4)
	sizeConstraint.MaxTextSize = textSize
	sizeConstraint.Parent = label

	local textShadow = addTextShadow(label)
	textShadow.Size = label.Size
	textShadow.Position = label.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)
	textShadow.ZIndex = 4
end

	auroraTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, mobile and 52 or 64)
	auroraTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	auroraTitle.ZIndex = 3
	auroraTitle.Parent = titleHolder

	local sizeConstraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")

	sizeConstraint.MaxTextSize = mobile and 34 or 44
	sizeConstraint.Parent = auroraTitle

	local textShadow = addTextShadow(auroraTitle)

	textShadow.Position = auroraTitle.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)

local function createBackgroundRegion(parent, mobile)
	local backgroundRoot = Instance.new("Frame")

		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, PALETTE.backgroundTop),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, PALETTE.backgroundAccent),

	bloomTop.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.02)
	bloomTop.Size = UDim2.fromScale(mobile and 0.92 or 0.62, mobile and 0.28 or 0.36)
	bloomTop.Parent = backgroundRoot

	local bloomTopCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	bloomTopCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	bloomTopCorner.Parent = bloomTop

	local bloomBottom = Instance.new("Frame")
	bloomBottom.Name = "BloomBottom"
	bloomBottom.BackgroundColor3 = PALETTE.nativeCyanSoft
	bloomBottom.BackgroundTransparency = 0.94
	bloomBottom.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bloomBottom.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	bloomBottom.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1)
	bloomBottom.Size = UDim2.fromScale(mobile and 1 or 0.84, mobile and 0.22 or 0.3)
	bloomBottom.Parent = backgroundRoot

	local bloomBottomCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	bloomBottomCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	bloomBottomCorner.Parent = bloomBottom

	local backgroundOrnaments = Instance.new("Frame")
	backgroundOrnaments.Name = "BackgroundOrnaments"
	backgroundOrnaments.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	backgroundOrnaments.BorderSizePixel = 0
	backgroundOrnaments.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	backgroundOrnaments.Parent = backgroundRoot

	local function corner(name, anchorX, anchorY, posX, posY, rotation)
		local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
		holder.Name = name
		holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
		holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(anchorX, anchorY)
		holder.Position = UDim2.new(posX, 0, posY, 0)
		holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(mobile and 96 or 140, mobile and 96 or 140)
		holder.Rotation = rotation
		holder.Parent = backgroundOrnaments

		local ring1 = Instance.new("Frame")
		ring1.Name = "RingOuter"
		ring1.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		ring1.BorderSizePixel = 0
		ring1.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		ring1.Parent = holder

		local stroke1 = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke1.Color = PALETTE.nativeGold
		stroke1.Thickness = mobile and 2 or 3
		stroke1.Transparency = 0.45
		stroke1.Parent = ring1

		local corner1 = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner1.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, mobile and 18 or 26)
		corner1.Parent = ring1

		local ring2 = Instance.new("Frame")
		ring2.Name = "RingInner"
		ring2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		ring2.BorderSizePixel = 0
		ring2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mobile and 12 or 18, mobile and 12 or 18)
		ring2.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(mobile and 24 or 36), 1, -(mobile and 24 or 36))
		ring2.Parent = holder

		local stroke2 = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke2.Color = PALETTE.nativeCyan
		stroke2.Thickness = 2
		stroke2.Transparency = 0.52
		stroke2.Parent = ring2

		local corner2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, mobile and 12 or 18)
		corner2.Parent = ring2
	end

	corner("TopLeft", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	corner("TopRight", 1, 0, 1, 0, 0)
	corner("BottomLeft", 0, 1, 0, 1, 0)
	corner("BottomRight", 1, 1, 1, 1, 0)
end

local function createMenuDock(parent, mobile)

	mainMenuDock.Name = "MainMenuDock"
	mainMenuDock.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	mainMenuDock.BorderSizePixel = 0
	mainMenuDock.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	mainMenuDock.Position = mobile and UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.57) or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.48)

	mainMenuDock.Parent = parent

	local menuScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	menuScale.Name = "MenuScale"
	menuScale.Parent = mainMenuDock

	local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	list.Padding = UDim.new(0, mobile and 12 or 16)
	list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	list.Parent = mainMenuDock

	createTitleBlock(mainMenuDock, mobile)

	local playButton = createSliceButton("PlayButton", PLAY_BUTTON_URI, {185, 89, 839, 403}, 0.2, mobile and 74 or 86)
	playButton.LayoutOrder = 2
	playButton.Parent = mainMenuDock
	populateButtonContent(playButton, "Play", "play", 28, mobile and 22 or 24)

	local settingsButton = createSliceButton("SettingsButton", MENU_BUTTON_URI, {185, 64, 839, 287}, 0.2, mobile and 64 or 68)
	settingsButton.LayoutOrder = 3
	settingsButton.Parent = mainMenuDock
	populateButtonContent(settingsButton, "Settings", "settings", 28, mobile and 22 or 24)

	local creditsButton = createSliceButton("CreditsButton", MENU_BUTTON_URI, {185, 64, 839, 287}, 0.2, mobile and 64 or 68)
	creditsButton.LayoutOrder = 4
	creditsButton.Parent = mainMenuDock
	populateButtonContent(creditsButton, "Credits", "info", 28, mobile and 22 or 24)
end

	backdrop.AutoButtonColor = false
	backdrop.Visible = false
	backdrop.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	backdrop.ZIndex = 20
	backdrop.Parent = parent
	return backdrop
end

local function createCloseButton(name)
	local button = createSliceButton(name, CLOSE_BUTTON_URI, {185, 93, 839, 419}, 0.2, 52)
	button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52)
	button.ZIndex = 30

	local visual = button:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.BorderSizePixel = 0
	content.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	content.ZIndex = 32
	content.Parent = visual

	local closeIcon = createNexusIcon(content, "close", {
		name = name .. "Icon",
		size = 24,
		padding = 8,
		color = PALETTE.panelText,
	})
	closeIcon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	closeIcon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	closeIcon.ZIndex = 33
	for _, desc in ipairs(closeIcon:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Frame") then
			desc.ZIndex = 33
		end
	end

	return button

local function createPanelHost(parent, nodeName, imageUri, sliceCenterArray, mobile, sizeScale, sizeOffset, zIndex)
	local host = Instance.new("Frame")
	host.Name = nodeName .. "Host"
	host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	host.BorderSizePixel = 0
	host.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	host.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	host.Size = UDim2.new(sizeScale.X.Scale, sizeScale.X.Offset + sizeOffset.X, sizeScale.Y.Scale, sizeScale.Y.Offset + sizeOffset.Y)
	host.Visible = false
	host.ZIndex = zIndex
	host.Parent = parent

	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Name = "OpenScale"
	scale.Scale = 1
	scale.Parent = host

	local shadow = Instance.new("Frame")
	shadow.Name = "Shadow"
	shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shadow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	shadow.ZIndex = zIndex
	shadow.Parent = host
	applyNativeShadow(shadow, "NativeShadow", zIndex, 0.68)

	local panel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	panel.Name = nodeName
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	panel.Image = imageUri
	panel.ImageColor3 = PALETTE.white
	panel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	panel.SliceCenter = Rect.new(sliceCenterArray[1], sliceCenterArray[2], sliceCenterArray[3], sliceCenterArray[4])
	panel.SliceScale = 0.2
	panel.ZIndex = zIndex + 1
	panel.Parent = host

	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.BorderSizePixel = 0
	content.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	content.ZIndex = zIndex + 2
	content.Parent = panel

	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, mobile and 22 or 24)
	padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, mobile and 18 or 20)
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, mobile and 20 or 24)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, mobile and 20 or 24)
	padding.Parent = content

	return host, panel, content
end

local function createSettingsModal(parent, mobile)
	local host, panel, content = createPanelHost(
		parent,
		"SettingsModal",
		SETTINGS_PANEL_URI,
		{185, 94, 839, 427},
		mobile,
		UDim2.new(mobile and 0.88 or 0.34, 0, mobile and 0.42 or 0.42, 0),
		Vector2.new(0, 0),
		24
	)

	local panelControllerBehavior = Instance.new("Folder")
	panelControllerBehavior.Name = "PanelControllerBehavior"
	panelControllerBehavior.Parent = host

	local header = Instance.new("Frame")
	header.Name = "Header"
	header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	header.BorderSizePixel = 0
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58)
	header.ZIndex = 27

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local root = script.Parent
local source = root:WaitForChild("_NexusSource")
local Responsive = require(source.Runtime.Responsive)
local ButtonEffects = require(source.Runtime.ButtonEffects)

Responsive.bind(root)

local connections = {}
local feedbackControllers = {}
local dragging = nil

local function connect(signal, fn)
	local c = signal:Connect(fn)
	table.insert(connections, c)
	return c
end

local function registerFeedback(button)
	if feedbackControllers[button] then
		return
	end

	local visual = button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
	local shadow = button:FindFirstChild("Shadow")
	local ok, controller = pcall(function()
		return ButtonEffects.bind(button, {
			visual = visual,
			shadow = shadow,
			hoverScale = button.Name == "PlayButton" and 1.03 or 1.025,
			pressScale = button.Name == "PlayButton" and 0.97 or 0.965,
			duration = 0.12,
			sounds = false,
			hoverEnabled = true,
			animations = true,
		})
	end)
	if ok and controller then
		feedbackControllers[button] = controller
	end
end

local function descendantsByName(name)
	local list = {}
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant.Name == name then
			table.insert(list, descendant)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function firstDescendantOf(instance, name)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant.Name == name then
			return descendant
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function tween(instance, info, goal)
	local t = TweenService:Create(instance, info, goal)
	t:Play()
	return t
end

local openInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local closeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
local fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local activeModalName = nil

local function getVisibleGroup()
	local desktop = firstDescendantOf(root, "_NexusDesktop")
	local mobile = firstDescendantOf(root, "_NexusMobile")
	if mobile and mobile.Visible then
		return mobile
	end
	return desktop
end

local function setBackdropVisible(group, visible)
	if not group then
		return
	end
	local backdrop = firstDescendantOf(group, "ModalBackdrop")
	if not backdrop then
		return
	end
	if visible then
		backdrop.Visible = true
		backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tween(backdrop, fadeInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.42 })
	else
		local t = tween(backdrop, closeInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
		connect(t.Completed, function()
			if activeModalName == nil then
				backdrop.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function openModal(name)
	local group = getVisibleGroup()
	if not group then
		return
	end

	for _, modalName in ipairs({ "SettingsModalHost", "CreditsModalHost" }) do
		local host = firstDescendantOf(group, modalName)
		if host then
			if modalName == name then
				host.Visible = true
				host.GroupTransparency = nil
				local scale = host:FindFirstChild("OpenScale")
				if scale then
					scale.Scale = GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled and 1 or 0.96
					tween(scale, openInfo, { Scale = 1 })
				end
				host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				tween(host, fadeInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
			else
				host.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

	activeModalName = name
	setBackdropVisible(group, true)
end

local function closeModal(name)
	local group = getVisibleGroup()
	if not group then
		return
	end

	local host = firstDescendantOf(group, name)
	if not host then
		return
	end

	local scale = host:FindFirstChild("OpenScale")
	if scale and not GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
		tween(scale, closeInfo, { Scale = 0.97 })
	end

	local done = tween(host, closeInfo, {})
	connect(done.Completed, function()
		host.Visible = false
	end)

	if activeModalName == name then
		activeModalName = nil
		setBackdropVisible(group, false)
	end
end

local function closeAllModals()
	for _, groupName in ipairs({ "_NexusDesktop", "_NexusMobile" }) do
		for _, descendant in ipairs(descendantsByName(groupName)) do
			local backdrop = firstDescendantOf(descendant, "ModalBackdrop")
			if backdrop then
				backdrop.Visible = false
				backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
			local settings = firstDescendantOf(descendant, "SettingsModalHost")
			if settings then
				settings.Visible = false
			end
			local credits = firstDescendantOf(descendant, "CreditsModalHost")
			if credits then
				credits.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end
	activeModalName = nil
end

local function updateToggle(toggle)
	local state = toggle:FindFirstChild("State")
	local visual = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	if not state or not visual then
		return
	end
	local onNode = visual:FindFirstChild("MusicToggleOn")
	local offNode = visual:FindFirstChild("MusicToggleOff")
	if onNode then
		onNode.Visible = state.Value
	end
	if offNode then
		offNode.Visible = not state.Value
	end
end

local function setSliderValue(slider, alpha)
	alpha = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
	local valueObject = slider:FindFirstChild("Value")
	if valueObject then
		valueObject.Value = alpha
	end

	local clip = slider:FindFirstChild("TrackFillClip")
	local handle = slider:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if clip then
		clip.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, clip.Size.Y.Scale, clip.Size.Y.Offset)
	end
	if handle then
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
	end

	local volumeRow = slider.Parent
	if volumeRow then
		local volumeValue = volumeRow:FindFirstChild("VolumeValue")
		if volumeValue and volumeValue:IsA("TextLabel") then
			volumeValue.Text = tostring(math.floor(alpha * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
		end
	end
end

local function sliderAlphaFromInput(slider, inputPositionX)
	local absolutePosition = slider.AbsolutePosition
	local absoluteSize = slider.AbsoluteSize
	if absoluteSize.X <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return math.clamp((inputPositionX - absolutePosition.X) / absoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
end

for _, buttonName in ipairs({
	"PlayButton",
	"SettingsButton",
	"CreditsButton",
	"SettingsCloseButton",
	"CreditsCloseButton",
}) do
	for _, button in ipairs(descendantsByName(buttonName)) do
		if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
			registerFeedback(button)
		end
	end
end

for _, toggle in ipairs(descendantsByName("MusicToggle")) do
	if toggle:IsA("GuiButton") then
		updateToggle(toggle)
		connect(toggle.Activated, function()
			local state = toggle:FindFirstChild("State")
			if state then
				state.Value = not state.Value
				updateToggle(toggle)
			end
		end)
		registerFeedback(toggle)
	end
end

for _, slider in ipairs(descendantsByName("VolumeSlider")) do
	local valueObject = slider:FindFirstChild("Value")
	if valueObject then
		setSliderValue(slider, valueObject.Value)
	end

	local hitArea = slider:FindFirstChild("HitArea")
	local handle = slider:FindFirstChild("Handle")

	local function beginDrag(x)
		dragging = slider
		setSliderValue(slider, sliderAlphaFromInput(slider, x))
	end

	if hitArea and hitArea:IsA("GuiButton") then
		connect(hitArea.InputBegan, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				beginDrag(input.Position.X)
			end
		end)
	end

	if handle and handle:IsA("GuiButton") then
		registerFeedback(handle)
		connect(handle.InputBegan, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				beginDrag(input.Position.X)
			end
		end)
	end
end

connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		setSliderValue(dragging, sliderAlphaFromInput(dragging, input.Position.X))
	end
end)

connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = nil
	end
end)

			controller:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	table.clear(feedbackControllers)
end)

local Responsive = {}
function Responsive.bind(root)
    local cameraConnection
    local connections = {}
    local function update()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        local mobile = math.min(size.X, size.Y) < 600
        for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if node.Name == "_NexusDesktop" then node.Visible = not mobile end
                if node.Name == "_NexusMobile" then node.Visible = mobile end
            end
        end
    end
    local function observeCamera()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then cameraConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update) end
        update()
    end
    table.insert(connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(observeCamera))
    local function cleanup()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    table.insert(connections, root.Destroying:Connect(cleanup))
    observeCamera()
    return cleanup
end
return Responsive

-- Original reference implementation from 06-ui-motion-and-interaction.md
-- Reviewed 2026-09-11. Not Roblox Studio runtime-verified.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ButtonFeedback = {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastSoundAt = { hover = -math.huge, click = -math.huge }

-- Backward compatible: bind(button, childVisual) or bind(button, options).
-- Prefer options.visual = the stable button's child Visual frame.
function ButtonFeedback.bind(button, visualOrOptions, options)
    local visual
    if typeof(visualOrOptions) == "Instance" then
        visual = visualOrOptions
        options = options or {}
    else
        options = visualOrOptions or {}
        visual = options.visual or button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
    end
    assert(button:IsA("GuiButton"), "expected a GuiButton")
    assert(visual:IsA("GuiObject") and (visual == button or visual:IsDescendantOf(button)),
        "visual must be a child visual inside the button")
    assert(not bound[button], "button already has a feedback binding")
    assert(not visual:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"),
        "visual UIScale already has an owner")
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Name = "FeedbackScale"
    scale.Parent = visual
    local alive, focused = true, GuiService.SelectedObject == button
    local currentTween = nil
    local shadowTween = nil
    local connections = {}
    local sounds = {}
    local originalAutoColor = button.AutoButtonColor
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local controller = {}
    bound[button] = controller
    local previousState = nil
    local hoverScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.hoverScale) or 1.05, 1, 1.1)
    local pressScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.pressScale) or 0.95, 0.85, 1)
    local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(options.duration) or 0.12, 0.06, 0.3)
    local shadow = options.shadow
    local shadowPosition = shadow and shadow.Position

    local function soundFor(kind, soundId)
        if type(soundId) ~= "string" or not soundId:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then return end
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "Feedback_" .. kind
        sound.SoundId = soundId
        sound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(options.volume) or 0.18, 0, 0.35)
        sound.Parent = button
        sounds[kind] = sound
    end
    soundFor("hover", options.hoverSound)
    soundFor("click", options.clickSound)

    local function playSound(kind)
        if not alive or not button.Interactable or options.sounds == false then return end
        local sound = sounds[kind]
        local now = os.clock()
        local delay = kind == "hover" and 0.12 or 0.08
        if not sound or now - lastSoundAt[kind] < delay then return end
        lastSoundAt[kind] = now
        sound.TimePosition = 0
        sound:Play()
    end

    local function pointerAvailable()
        return UserInputService.MouseEnabled
            and UserInputService:GetLastInputType() ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    local function refresh()
        if not alive then return end
        local state = button.GuiState
        local target = 1
        if button.Interactable then
            if state == Enum.GuiState.Press then
                target = pressScale
            elseif (state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false) or focused then
                target = hoverScale
            end
        end
        if state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and previousState ~= state and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false then
            playSound("hover")
        end
        previousState = state
        if currentTween then
            currentTween:Cancel()
            currentTween = nil
        end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled or options.animations == false then
            scale.Scale = 1
            if shadow then shadow.Position = shadowPosition end
            return
        end
        currentTween = TweenService:Create(scale,
            TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = target })
        currentTween:Play()
        if shadow then
            local offset = state == Enum.GuiState.Press and -2 or 0
            shadowTween = TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(duration),
                { Position = shadowPosition + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset) })
            shadowTween:Play()
        end
    end

    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("Interactable"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
        focused = true
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
        focused = false
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = GuiService
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("ReducedMotionEnabled"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
        playSound("click")
    end)

    function controller:Destroy()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel() end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _, sound in pairs(sounds) do sound:Destroy() end
        bound[button] = nil
        scale:Destroy()
        pcall(function() button.AutoButtonColor = originalAutoColor end)
        if shadow then pcall(function() shadow.Position = shadowPosition end) end
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Destroying:Connect(function()
        controller:Destroy()
    end)
    refresh()
    return controller
end

return ButtonFeedback
